snippet.title: The Adventures of Emilie in Paris
snippet.description:
Trailer video game #theadventuresofemilieinparis :  The adventures of Emilie in Paris (in french: Les aventures d'Emilie à Paris). 2D platform game inspired by 1990s genre classics, enriched with an original universe, realistic and unique animations, and modern techniques. The action takes place in a stylized Paris blending Haussmannian buildings in cartoon style with realistic environments.
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028870
